question: What is the title of the official song for the ICC Men's Champions Trophy 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jeeto Baazi Khel Ke.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The ICC released the official song of the ICC Men’s Champions Trophy 2025, titled "Jeeto Baazi Khel Ke."**
 
• **The song is performed by Atif Aslam **and aims to build excitement ahead of the tournament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The song is produced by Abdullah Siddiqui, with lyrics written by Adnan Dhool and Asfandyar Asad.**
 
• It visually celebrates Pakistan’s culture, showcasing its streets, markets, and stadiums.
 
• **The ICC Men's Champions Trophy 2025 will be held **from February 19 to March 9 in **Pakistan and the UAE.**
 
• The tournament features the world’s top eight teams competing in 15 matches over 19 days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

 __
